details:
labelearth-api-python-client is a renamed copy of Google's google-api-python-client 2.170.0 (googleapiclient becomes labelearthapiclient) that keeps the upstream author metadata (Google LLC, googleapis-packages@google.com) but is not published by Google. It is the API client dependency of labelearthengine-api, a renamed copy of Google's Earth Engine client from the same publisher. Its one functional change sends Google Earth Engine value:compute and maps requests, with the caller's Google OAuth token attached, to three AWS Lambda function URLs controlled by the publisher instead of to Google. Nothing in the package or its description discloses the redirection; its code comments and its routing of compute-heavy requests would also fit a relay for users who cannot reach Google directly, but either way the user's Google OAuth token reaches a third party without the package saying so.

Trigger: any Earth Engine compute or map request made through the library (labelearthengine-api makes them on every such call).

- labelearthapiclient/discovery.py:1069 defines findNoXyz, which looks for Image.reduceRegion, Image.reduceRegions, Image.sample, Image.classify, Stack.transform and S1.transform in the request body
- labelearthapiclient/discovery.py:1191-1199 replaces the URL of a request ending in value:compute with https://qimghtmjhshx2gyj2joihsw6b40btyxe.lambda-url.us-west-2.on.aws, and of one ending in maps with https://eqphqftdmhunp24bdxyllrivuy0qznpu.lambda-url.us-west-2.on.aws (findNoXyz matches) or https://tggzlaklx64urltctfj25ybwnq0ccagk.lambda-url.us-west-2.on.aws (otherwise)
- labelearthapiclient/_auth.py:122 sends requests through google_auth_httplib2.AuthorizedHttp, which attaches the OAuth bearer token to every request whatever its host

The rest of the library matches google-api-python-client 2.170.0 apart from its name, README and setup metadata. Every version is affected: 2.170.0 (2026-01-06) has the same redirection at the same lines with two Lambda URLs (ht6macueeae25ilc3vq5y5adgu0fvtfu for value:compute, l5ov5gum3lkqw3ojvyt76om2ni0zyrxp for maps); 2.170.1 and 2.170.2 use the three above. Line references are from 2.170.2 (sdist sha256 2927cc1b577a2b6ba709ab3e688d4f2d2d2842dd3e5e3819193a63bc868823a2).

Found by Bitbison (https://bitbison.io) while reviewing labelearthengine-api, which Bitbison's registry flagged in its backfill of packages already on PyPI. The package has carried the redirection since its first version on 2026-01-06 (ten months) with no report; pypistats counts 973 downloads of the package in the last 180 days.
